line.name: E.P. Carrillo La Historia TAA 656
line.background_text: A TAA-exclusive release using the same blend as the regular La Historia line (already on site), packaged in a unique thick-ring 6x56 toro vitola sold only to TAA member retailers, limited to 1,000 boxes. Produced at Tabacalera La Alianza S.A.

vitolas.summary_review: TAA-exclusive thick-ring vitola using the standard La Historia blend, sold in limited 10-count boxes.

research_notes: Same underlying blend as regular La Historia but a unique exclusive vitola/packaging, not part of La Historia's standard lineup - justifies its own entry distinct from the plain La Historia already on site. No independent critic score found.

research_sources.supports: blend, size, price, box count, factory
